policy.what: China's SAMR fined the Pinduoduo platform operator ~RMB1.5bn (part of RMB3.6bn across 7 platforms) for E-Commerce Law and food-safety violations, plus a nine-month halt on onboarding new cake vendors

EU: European Commission opened a DSA investigation into Temu in October 2024; in July 2025 it preliminarily found Temu in breach of the illegal-products risk-assessment duty (possible fine up to 6% of global turnover); a separate CPC Network consumer-law inquiry is ongoing
US: DOJ/FTC INFORM Consumers Act case against Temu settled in September 2025 with a $2m civil penalty and a consent order

US state attorney general suits against PDD/Temu: Arkansas (June 2024, amended May 2025), Nebraska (June 2025; motion to dismiss denied 2026-04-09), Kentucky (July 2025), Arizona (December 2025), Texas (February 2026)
Temu suspended in Vietnam (December 2024) and Uzbekistan (March 2025); not resumed as of the 20-F (April 2026)
Pinduoduo listed on the USTR Notorious Markets list for counterfeits since 2019

giving.name: Starry Night Charitable Trust (2.37% of PDD shares pledged for biomedical science, agriculture and food research); further share donations totalled 10.11% by June 2020

watch.what: PDD Q3 2026 earnings, likely mid/late November (Q3 2025 was reported 2025-11-18). Q2 2026: revenue RMB112.4bn (+8%), net income RMB27.2bn (-12%)
European Commission DSA non-compliance decision on Temu (fine up to 6% of worldwide turnover)
US state AG cases (Nebraska proceeding after dismissal denied; Arkansas, Kentucky, Arizona, Texas pending)
